'''Brelshen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who worked for [[IsoTech]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was stationned at [[Scrapheap Point]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].
